<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: x-large;"><i>Helping Liu Bang to Escape the Siege of Xingyang by Diverting the
Enemy's Attention</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">
When under <u>siege</u> in Xingyang, by Xiang Yu's army, Chen Ping
had troops sent to the eastern wall of the city to pretend to break
through there at night. While Xiang Yu's army counterattacked at the
eastern wall, Chen Ping brought Liu Bang out of the city through the
western wall unnoticed [18], [20].</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Helping
Liu Bang to Escape the Siege of Xingyang by Diverting the </span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><i>Enemy's
Attention </i><span style="font-style: normal;">is
an application of the 21st stratagem, </span><i>The
Golden Cicada Sloughs off Its Shell</i><span style="font-style: normal;">,
which</span> is
associated with both the eighteenth hexagram, <i>Mountain
over Wind</i>.
Movement, and the 48th hexagram, <i>Water
outside of Wind </i><span style="font-style: normal;">[1],
[28]</span>.</span></p>

<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="font-size: x-large;"><b><span style="color: #333333;">Sample Sentences 38:</span></b></span></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section90" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;">
	<span style="color: #333333;">
    1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他应该是生物学家，而不是化学家。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: I don’t think he’s
	 a biologist, or a chemist.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他的头发是卷的，而不是直的。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: His hair is curly,
	not straight.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	3) </span><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="color: #333333;">我们没有订书机，夹子可以吗？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    4) </span></span><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large">他的小狗被其他狗围攻了。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他因为揭露真相被惩罚了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们主管的头发完全白了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我的老婆在那个公司的人力资源部。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他的爸妈把他的吉他藏起来了，说完成作</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;业后会给他。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她会弹吉他还会打鼓，但是不会弹钢琴。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    10) </span></span><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> <span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large">他们被警察包围了，没办法逃走。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那个物理学家有自己的公司去造发动</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;机。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">普通人和勇士的差异是：普通人把难题</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;当作不好的运气，但是勇士把难题当作挑战。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	13) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">一些学习心理学的人当了政治家。</span></span></span></p>
